message:
Subject: Navigating iRhythm Technologies' 510(k) Submission and Organizational Changes

Dear Quentin,

I hope this message finds you well. As the President and CEO of iRhythm Technologies, Inc., I understand that your company is diligently preparing for the 510(k) submission deadline in May 2024. Navigating the complex FDA regulatory landscape while managing recent staffing changes can be challenging.
